decisions.reason: The original UN WUP 2025 row identifies Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina, at 43.8576941297522 N, 18.3731462143768 E with 253857 persons. More decisively, the 2026-10-08 coverage recheck explicitly investigated Sarajevo: it inspected the FGU cadastral services and Sarajevo Canton WebCity, probed anonymous WFS capabilities and public viewers, and recorded restricted or unreachable access without a verified parcel response. Fresh first-party WebCity content still identifies Sarajevo cadastral data, while the anonymous WFS capabilities request returned HTTP 403. This is a confirmed prior investigation of the same city, so WUP409 stays excluded from pending research. The WUP rank, point and population remain unchanged. Service access walls and the absent verified sample leave parcel custody and public geometry unresolved; no live adapter or citywide absence is established.
